title: Tests of workspace probes assert the endpoint sequence on the mocked http_request
answers: how to test which capability endpoints were queried in workspace tests
mock http_request side_effect endpoint order assertion
test convention for multi-endpoint REST probes
body:
Convention: when a test mocks mlflow.utils.server_info.http_request with a side_effect list for multiple capability calls, capture the mock (mock_http) and assert the endpoint order via [call.kwargs['endpoint'] for call in mock_http.call_args_list], as the neighboring capability tests do.
Why: a reviewer flagged a mock with no call assertion, because the test then does not prove both server-info and server-features were queried.
For single-endpoint paths, assert the list is just [SERVER_INFO_ENDPOINT].
applies: Unit tests for workspace support probing in tests/store/tracking and tests/store/model_registry.
says: Workspace detection fails to prove both server info and feature endpoints were checked.
Ensure workspace capability tests verify the exact order of queried server endpoints.
Workspace support tests should confirm that server feature endpoints were actually called.
Validate that workspace detection queries both server information and capability flags.
search: Tests probing workspace support across tracking and model registry stores must assert the endpoint order on mocked http_request via call.kwargs['endpoint']. This assertion verifies that multi-endpoint probes query both server-info and server-features endpoints, while single-endpoint paths assert [SERVER_INFO_ENDPOINT]. Applies to unit tests in tests/store/tracking and tests/store/model_registry that mock mlflow.utils.server_info.http_request.
